values.value: Before you start, one thing about how we will read your answers. We can read your current Marketing Cloud estate directly, so the journey, data extension and automation figures in your readout are measured rather than described. Nothing writes to Marketing Cloud Next yet, so the target-side model is the accelerator's working picture of the platform and several entries are pending verification against a real tenant.
